scope: EVPlug / EvOne public client role and roaming semantics

observed_claims: EVPlug states that its recharge card can be used across public stations and major fast-charging networks in Morocco.
EVPlug states a 99% coverage claim for Morocco.
EVPlug directs users to its app for nearby stations and public-station tariffs.
EvOne lets drivers check prices beforehand.
EvOne exposes charger availability and real-time updates.
EvOne supports remote start/stop and payments.

modeling_resolution.cpo_operator: station-specific; MUST NOT default to EVPlug or EvOne solely because a station is visible/usable in EvOne
modeling_resolution.app_source_access_network: EVPlug / EvOne when observation originates from the EvOne client or EVPlug roaming access
modeling_resolution.tariff_channel: EVPlug/EvOne eMSP/roaming tariff when shown by the client; do not overwrite a native CPO direct tariff
modeling_resolution.status_source: EVPlug/EvOne only when the observed status originates from that client; prefer verified native CPO status when fresher/authoritative

interpretation: Official public materials support classifying EVPlug/EvOne primarily as an eMSP/access-network and client surface spanning multiple charging networks. Visibility or payment capability in EvOne is therefore not evidence that EVPlug/EvOne is the physical CPO. This is particularly relevant when cross-checking EVGO/Nareva sites: EVGO native cp.evgo.ma remains the preferred status source when available and fresher, while EvOne can remain a roaming corroboration source.
